title: Purpose in Christ
definition: Purpose in Christ is the truth that believers find their identity, calling, service, and hope in belonging to Jesus.
summary: Purpose is found not in self-definition but in belonging to Christ and living for His glory.
christFocus: Jesus redeems His people and gives them a new life of worship, obedience, service, and mission.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Purpose in Christ begins with belonging to Him. People were created for God's glory, but sin twists purpose toward self, idols, approval, or despair.

In Christ, believers are forgiven, renewed, and called into good works prepared by God. Purpose is not limited to platform, health, success, or visibility. It includes worship, obedience, love, service, endurance, and witness.

This doctrine is especially precious for people who feel written off. Christ gives purpose even in weakness, limitation, recovery, disability, or hidden faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people believe they have no purpose because they are limited, overlooked, or defined by failure. Purpose in Christ matters because calling comes from the Savior, not from worldly measures of usefulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask how your life can glorify Christ today. Serve where you are, use what you have, and refuse the lie that weakness or history cancels God's purpose.
